nodes.label: Codebase Snapshot Ring Buffer
nodes.rationale: A fixed-size buffer overwrites old snapshots and provides constant-time trend reads for dashboard access.

nodes.label: API Sliding Window
nodes.rationale: A 24-hour sliding window supports per-request logging and recent aggregate health calculations.

nodes.label: Weighted Project Health Score
nodes.rationale: Each health pillar is normalized and weighted so disparate operational signals can be combined into one project pulse.

nodes.label: Project Health Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Defines a layered project-health implementation that reuses existing Token Burn infrastructure and separates data collection, scoring, and dashboard presentation.

nodes.label: Token Burn Native Analytics Engine
nodes.rationale: Uses append-only activity logs, precomputed snapshot rings, provider state, and bounded leaderboards to keep write-heavy analytics separate from fast dashboard reads.

nodes.label: Agent Entry Point
nodes.rationale: Routes non-Claude agents to CLAUDE.md as the repository session rail.

nodes.label: YVON Session Rail
nodes.rationale: Defines mandatory task classification, routing, discovery, retrieval, build, and verification workflow.

nodes.label: Session Complete Report
nodes.rationale: Records the completed six-department build and verification results.

nodes.label: Session Handoff
nodes.rationale: Preserves the resumable build state and sequencing for the Risk and ESG department.

nodes.label: Image-First Frontend Workflow
nodes.rationale: Uses generated design references as the primary visual source before analysis and implementation.

nodes.label: Image to Code Skill
nodes.rationale: Requires image-first design generation, deep visual analysis, and faithful frontend implementation.

nodes.label: TS-004 Wholesale UI Port
nodes.rationale: The old YVON-OS front end is adopted wholesale first for fidelity, with data wiring deliberately deferred until after import.

nodes.label: Egress Allowlist Authoring
nodes.rationale: Derives the allowlist from the tool registry so hand-maintained network permissions cannot silently drift.

nodes.label: Least-Privilege Grants
nodes.rationale: Treats access as a revocable loan against a cited need and makes shrinkage the purpose of audits.

nodes.label: MCP and Tool Registry
nodes.rationale: Makes every external capability traceable and plan-checkable through registration, grants, linting, and append-only audit history.

nodes.label: Tool Evaluation Intake
nodes.rationale: Requires security screening, pre-written criteria, sandboxed trials, and recorded verdicts before tools enter the fleet.

nodes.label: Experiment Backlog Skill
nodes.rationale: Turns growth work into a capacity-honest, pre-registered queue whose results compound through graduation and loss archives.

nodes.label: Asset Pipeline Skill
nodes.rationale: Makes batch production mechanical so every asset receives QA, naming, and traceable delivery rather than volume-based exceptions.

nodes.label: Image Style Guide Skill
nodes.rationale: Freezes operator-approved visual parameters from the brand kit and real test outputs to prevent per-deadline visual drift.

nodes.label: Social Content Calendar
nodes.rationale: The calendar is designed as pulse's planning spine and uses a three-layer hook design separating durable psychology, volatile platform knowledge, and brand-specific evidence.

nodes.label: Hooks Register Template
nodes.rationale: The register is append-only and intentionally outranks generic hook patterns because it records observed outcomes for the brand's own audience.

nodes.label: Platform Playbook Template
nodes.rationale: The playbook is deliberately dated and refreshable because platform-specific execution knowledge is volatile.

nodes.label: Hermes Contabo Configuration Record
nodes.rationale: Records the installed Hermes tool, skill, and MCP surface without storing secrets or acting as the live configuration.

nodes.label: Hermes Runtime Patch Plan
nodes.rationale: Keeps proposed runtime changes probe-gated so unconfirmed defects do not weaken the VPS.

nodes.label: Migrate Hermes: Hostinger to Contabo
nodes.rationale: Specifies a fresh re-provision rather than a lift-and-shift because the old host is resource-constrained and its state should not be treated as the source of truth.

nodes.label: YVON Hermes HTTP README
nodes.rationale: Documents the FastAPI wrapper that exposes Hermes as an SSE-streaming HTTP endpoint on the VPS.

nodes.label: Third-Party Risk Skill
nodes.rationale: Vendor assessments are proportional to data and access because a critical vendor's breach can become a breach of the business.

nodes.label: Board and Securities Counsel
nodes.rationale: Material non-public information requires board, operator, and securities counsel approval before release.

nodes.label: Classification-Driven Protection
nodes.rationale: Classification is explicitly the foundation for protection controls, DLP monitoring, and breach-notification decisions.

nodes.label: Operator Privileged Executor
nodes.rationale: The operator retains execution authority so the security function cannot become an uncontrolled attack surface.

nodes.label: Risk Register Spine
nodes.rationale: Centralizing gaps, findings, incidents, vendor issues, and exceptions prevents silent risk acceptance and gives each risk an owner and treatment.

nodes.label: Security Inversion
nodes.rationale: The security department detects, assesses, and recommends but holds no keys; the operator executes provisioning, containment, remediation, and other privileged changes.

nodes.label: herald Skill Routing
nodes.rationale: herald is the Comms & PR department leader and holds the department identity anchor.

nodes.label: 3P Updates Example
nodes.rationale: 3P updates are designed to be succinct, matter-of-fact, and readable in 30–60 seconds.

nodes.label: signal Skill Routing
nodes.rationale: signal is a non-leader agent, so it has no local identity and tone-inherits from herald.

nodes.label: Cloud Posture Checklist
nodes.rationale: Cloud findings are prioritized by exposure multiplied by data sensitivity, with veil supplying sensitivity and the operator or ops executing fixes.

nodes.label: bastion Command Triggers
nodes.rationale: bastion detects and specifies infrastructure findings while the operator or ops deploy gate performs privileged remediation.

nodes.label: cortex Command Triggers
nodes.rationale: Confirmed critical alerts route immediately to incident response, while lower-severity alerts follow monitoring and detection-engineering triage.

nodes.label: cortex Principles
nodes.rationale: cortex detects, triages, and recommends; the operator contains and remediates, preserving evidence before eradication.

nodes.label: Cybersecurity Redesign Plan
nodes.rationale: The redesign separates enterprise security from Engineering product security to cover human identity, infrastructure, monitoring, vendor risk, privacy, and security policy without duplicating aegis or cypher.

nodes.label: Joiner Mover Leaver Checklist
nodes.rationale: Mover access is subtractive rather than additive, and leaver deprovisioning covers identity, SaaS, shared accounts, secrets, devices, and physical access.

nodes.label: Keyring Configuration
nodes.rationale: Makes the operator, IdP, PAM, and vault the executors so keyring cannot hold keys or execute grants, revokes, or rotations.

nodes.label: keyring Command Triggers
nodes.rationale: Leaver deprovisioning covers all systems, and all grants, revocations, and rotations are executed by the operator or the relevant identity system.

nodes.label: Keyring Principles
nodes.rationale: Defines least privilege, prompt-complete deprovisioning, revoke-then-appeal, just-in-time privilege, and the security inversion as universal rules.

nodes.label: Keyring Skill Routing
nodes.rationale: Routes identity, access review, privileged access, and non-human credential workflows to specialized skills while keeping execution with the operator or infrastructure service.

nodes.label: Keyring Tool Requirements
nodes.rationale: Constrains keyring to read-and-recommend capabilities and explicitly prohibits write or execute access to IdP, PAM, and vault systems.

nodes.label: Veil
nodes.rationale: Veil classifies, monitors, and recommends for privacy and data protection, while the operator enforces blocks and sends notifications.

nodes.label: Breach Notification
nodes.rationale: Uses jurisdiction-specific clocks and approval routing because notification obligations vary by business jurisdiction and legal requirements.

nodes.label: Data Loss Prevention
nodes.rationale: Merges DLP detection methodology with a vendor-neutral policy framework so monitoring and response remain usable across DLP products.

nodes.label: veil Command Triggers
nodes.rationale: Classification precedes DLP monitoring and breach notification because protection and notification obligations depend on data sensitivity.

nodes.label: veil Principles
nodes.rationale: veil identifies classification gaps, DLP violations, and notification obligations while the operator enforces blocks and sends notifications.

nodes.label: Veil Skill Routing
nodes.rationale: Orders classification before protection, monitoring, and notification, with gaps routed to the risk register.

nodes.label: Risk Register Template
nodes.rationale: The append-only register ensures every risk is scored, treated, owned, or explicitly accepted, with higher-risk acceptance routed to the board.

nodes.label: Risk-Owning CISO Identity
nodes.rationale: warden treats security as managed, evidence-based risk rather than fear or security theater, while remaining least-privileged and unable to execute privileged changes.

nodes.label: Engineering Department Workflow
nodes.rationale: Engineering uses independent quality and security gates, operator-run destructive data changes, and a charter that is senior to agent convenience.

nodes.label: Training Program Design Skill
nodes.rationale: Designs and evaluates training backward from the business result, combining ADDIE, 70-20-10, and Kirkpatrick frameworks; this prevents course-only programs and success claims based only on participant reaction.

nodes.label: Grove Agent Config
nodes.rationale: Keeps operator-specific access, retention, escalation, and model fields explicit as fill-in debt rather than inventing values.

nodes.label: Grove Principles
nodes.rationale: Consolidates universal operating rules across grove's skills, including diagnosis before recommendation, structural-cause-first analysis, audit immutability, and scoped privacy handling.

nodes.label: Grove Skill Routing
nodes.rationale: Separates program-design, mechanism-level practice, gap-analysis, and training-operations scopes, while defining cross-skill handoffs and escalation boundaries.

nodes.label: Grove Tool Requirements
nodes.rationale: Explicitly distinguishes technical tool needs from runtime permission grants to prevent accidental over-granting.

nodes.label: Hire Agent
nodes.rationale: Owns the People & Culture hiring loop and coordinates workforce planning, hiring, ATS, payroll, and specialist-agent handoffs.

nodes.label: ATS Selection
nodes.rationale: Classifies current state, company size, and HRIS context before recommending an ATS, because platform fit changes with organizational stage.

nodes.label: Concept Library Skill
nodes.rationale: Provides memory across ideation runs by deduplicating at mechanism and angle level and registering every outcome.

nodes.label: Ad Platform Mechanics
nodes.rationale: The skill separates durable platform-agnostic principles from dated per-platform mechanics so volatile knowledge does not rot in static guidance.

nodes.label: Ad Thresholds
nodes.rationale: Thresholds are operator-configured and produce recommendations rather than autonomous spend changes, preserving fiduciary control.

nodes.label: Frontend Design System Discipline
nodes.rationale: Coordinates design-system choice, typography, color, layout, accessibility, motion, and responsive implementation rules.

nodes.label: Design Taste Frontend Skill
nodes.rationale: Provides anti-slop frontend design rules, system selection guidance, responsive constraints, and pre-flight checks.

nodes.label: Production RAG Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Combines retrieval, hybrid search, harness gates, strategy routing, generation, verification, feedback, and monitoring.

nodes.label: YVON Engine README
nodes.rationale: Describes the repository architecture, RAG pipeline, dashboard, commands, and project health.

nodes.label: WI-4 Browser Verification Gate
nodes.rationale: Uses real-browser verification to prove rendering, design checks, type safety, and screenshot output before shipment.

nodes.label: Playwright
nodes.rationale: Retained alongside Reticle because it drives arbitrary sites, validates real pixels, and serves as the release gate while Reticle verifies edits.

nodes.label: Reticle
nodes.rationale: Selected as the highest-value edit-time verification tool because it opens the running app, observes program behavior, and returns pass/fail results with file and line locations; it complements rather than replaces Playwright.

nodes.label: TS-006 Pre-Push Verification Gate
nodes.rationale: A local pre-push gate is chosen to prevent Vercel from functioning as CI and to catch static deployment regressions before push.

nodes.label: TS-007 External Verification Loop
nodes.rationale: The post-push Vercel watcher internalizes external build signals so failures can enter the existing auto-fix loop instead of requiring operator relay.

nodes.label: Skill Authoring Standards
nodes.rationale: Defines the house format and provenance law for every skill while preserving portability and auditability.

nodes.label: Sound Identity
nodes.rationale: Sound identity derives sonic rules from the other brand definers so audio does not contradict the kit, voice, or narrative arc.

nodes.label: Usage Licensing
nodes.rationale: Rights are verified against the actual license text and intended use before selection, because marketing-page descriptions are insufficient.

nodes.label: Brand Story Arcs
nodes.rationale: The architecture layer exists to prevent disconnected campaigns, enforce continuity, and ensure each chapter is specific to the brand.

nodes.label: Brandkit Image Generation Skill
nodes.rationale: Specifies a premium, strategic, image-led brand-kit generation process.

nodes.label: Design Taste Frontend v1
nodes.rationale: Preserves backward-compatible frontend taste rules and baseline design dials.

nodes.label: Full Output Enforcement Skill
nodes.rationale: Prevents incomplete deliverables, placeholder omissions, and truncated implementations.

nodes.label: High-End Visual Design Skill
nodes.rationale: Sets agency-level visual, typography, layout, materiality, and motion standards.

nodes.label: Vista
nodes.rationale: Vista produces rankings, flags, and grades but never finalizes cut, defer, accelerate, or resourcing decisions; those route to Marcus.

nodes.label: TS-005 UI Alignment
nodes.rationale: The dashboard is reshaped into a fleet control plane for YVON-owned brands, using Teams as the source of truth for agent identity.

nodes.label: Graph Drift GitHub Workflow
nodes.rationale: The workflow turns structure and event drift into visible CI failures instead of silent dashboard inconsistency.

nodes.label: YVON RAG
nodes.rationale: Provides chunk-level semantic retrieval instead of injecting whole documents, combining dense and sparse retrieval with agent-aware filtering, local embeddings, and feedback scoring.

nodes.label: Python Requirements
nodes.rationale: Lists dependencies for embeddings, vector storage, document processing, CLI tools, sandboxing, and scraping.

nodes.label: TS-009 Agent Chat and RBAC
nodes.rationale: The design uses magic-link authentication, owner and board-member roles, RLS-enforced department rooms, and CAOS/Hermes routing for dedicated team chat.

nodes.label: TS-010 Isometric Office
nodes.rationale: The office view uses deterministic progress derived from TASK-SPEC work items and live-first activity sources, with no fabricated tasks.

nodes.label: TS-011 Foundry Information Architecture
nodes.rationale: The former Skill Workshop becomes a Foundry hub with six functional subsystem routes, allowing real content to be wired in later without hiding the intended structure.

nodes.label: TS-019 CAOS Remediation
nodes.rationale: All seven audit findings are fixed in-repo, with plan-lock degradation made loud, the executor exercised by verification, and GATE 0 sign-offs enforced.

nodes.label: Strix
nodes.rationale: Fills the registry's security-testing gap with on-demand Docker-sandboxed autonomous pentesting rather than operating as a resident service.

nodes.label: System Harness Reorganization Plan
nodes.rationale: The plan defers high-risk moves until reference sweeps and verification can be performed, prioritizing the low-file-count pipelines merge first.

nodes.label: Task Dispatch
nodes.rationale: Creates a single signed TASK-SPEC with discovery decisions, contracts, ownership, boundaries, and acceptance criteria before multi-agent work activates.

nodes.label: Proto Agent
nodes.rationale: Builds experimental agents last so prototypes enter a governed, measured, and fixable fleet.

nodes.label: Relay Agent
nodes.rationale: Separates capability bookkeeping and allowlist authoring from runtime enforcement to prevent undisciplined integrations.

nodes.label: Scout Agent
nodes.rationale: Uses recurring, gap-matched scans and sandboxed evaluations so adoption is deliberate rather than driven by ecosystem noise.

nodes.label: Rio
nodes.rationale: Rio's paid-acquisition design keeps money-touching actions with the operator by default and uses independent measurement from kai.

nodes.label: Spark
nodes.rationale: Spark is Brand Studio's leader and final creative gate; its authority is derivative of written brand laws rather than personal taste.

nodes.label: Coherence QA
nodes.rationale: The gate checks visual, verbal, narrative, bleed, and coherence dimensions because individual lane checks cannot establish whether the whole asset works as one piece.

nodes.label: Tempo
nodes.rationale: Tempo is deliberately a documented no-op for brands without audio and activates only when audio content is present.

nodes.label: Weave
nodes.rationale: Weave makes brand storytelling cumulative through a canonical arc, chapter discipline, and continuity ledger.

nodes.label: signal Configuration
nodes.rationale: The configuration makes legal-fence, Neutral Zone, channel-cadence, archive, crisis, and refusal rules enforceable at runtime.

nodes.label: signal Principles
nodes.rationale: The non-leader signal agent uses Universal-only principles and inherits tone from herald rather than maintaining a separate identity-flavored principles section.

nodes.label: Veil Logical Book Requirements
nodes.rationale: Maps privacy and breach workflows to dedicated and inherited compliance scripts so classification, DLP, and notification decisions are operationalized.

nodes.label: warden Command Triggers
nodes.rationale: The risk register is the spine: every gap, finding, incident, and vendor issue lands there.

nodes.label: Echo Logical Book Requirements
nodes.rationale: The file records the logical scripts imported by Echo and documents clearance of previously reasoning-only investor-facing calculations.

nodes.label: Echo Configuration
nodes.rationale: The configuration is deliberately limited to the three fields that Echo skills actually reference and leaves deployment-specific values unfilled.

nodes.label: Echo Principles
nodes.rationale: Echo uses Universal-only principles because identity content is reserved for department leaders; reused Marcus tone was deliberately rejected.

nodes.label: Marcus Logical Book Requirements
nodes.rationale: The file maps Marcus's skills to shared logical scripts grounded in named finance, forecasting, decision-analysis, strategy, and bias sources.

nodes.label: Vista Logical Book Requirements
nodes.rationale: The file records Vista's dedicated and inherited statistical, forecasting, prioritization, and consistency scripts.

nodes.label: Sentinel
nodes.rationale: Detects and escalates constitutional boundary approaches and gate bypasses without ruling, freezing, or unwinding actions.

nodes.label: Audit Sampling Logical Requirement
nodes.rationale: Grounds coverage claims and sampling scope in cited audit-sampling and signal-detection methods rather than heuristics.

nodes.label: Sentinel Skill Routing
nodes.rationale: Separates trail design, output-content monitoring, and executed-action coverage while defining handoffs and non-ruling boundaries.

nodes.label: Growth and Partnerships README
nodes.rationale: Defines scope splits, coordination surfaces, load-bearing refusals, and cross-department routing for the four-agent fleet.

nodes.label: Delight Reference
nodes.rationale: Delight is reserved for moments that earn it and must never block core functionality.

nodes.label: Distill Reference
nodes.rationale: Simplification is framed as removing obstacles between users and their primary goal rather than merely removing features.

nodes.label: Extract Reference
nodes.rationale: Only patterns with repeated intent and meaningful reuse should be extracted; premature abstraction is explicitly discouraged.

nodes.label: WI-1 Apple Theme Tokens
nodes.rationale: Promotes Apple tokens into a full-page theme so surfaces, typography, color, and radius are cohesive and components avoid hardcoded colors.

nodes.label: WI-2 Apple Sidebar Rebuild
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds the shared sidebar on the Apple tokens while preserving WCAG AA contrast and a legible active state.

nodes.label: WI-3 Full Main Page Rebuild
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds all main-page sections as one cohesive Apple surface rather than updating only a single section.

nodes.label: Precedent
nodes.rationale: Its power is entirely epistemic: it never blocks or makes a ruling; it makes inconsistency impossible to miss and rule changes impossible to hide.

nodes.label: Pulse
nodes.rationale: Pulse was added in v3 because growing social media was the operator's stated reason for the department.

nodes.label: Quinn
nodes.rationale: Quinn blocks; it never builds, preserving independence between the release gate and implementation.

nodes.label: Raj
nodes.rationale: The backend never runs destructive data changes; schema and bulk data changes belong to Dana's migrations run by the operator.

nodes.label: Rank
nodes.rationale: Rank owns technical SEO execution only; SEO strategy and measurement belong to Kai, preventing double ownership.

nodes.label: Rio
nodes.rationale: Rio recommends campaign actions while the operator decides; automatic spend changes require an explicit configuration grant.

nodes.label: Sentinel
nodes.rationale: Sentinel detects and escalates; it never rules, freezes, or unwinds anything itself.

nodes.label: Spark
nodes.rationale: Spark has derivative authority and blocks only on written law, while taste remains advisory.

nodes.label: Tempo
nodes.rationale: For businesses doing no audio content, Tempo is an explicit documented no-op so the structure remains uniform.

nodes.label: Weave
nodes.rationale: Chapters accumulate and the canonical arc changes only through operator-adopted, versioned amendments, never silent retcons.

nodes.label: Nova
nodes.rationale: nova activates only when a business has a mobile app; otherwise frontend work is routed to mia.

nodes.label: VYON Master Structure
nodes.rationale: The structure separates human board legal authority from the advisory AI council and separates owned brands from external platform clients.

nodes.label: VYON Full Skills Catalog v2
nodes.rationale: The catalog centralizes operating-system skills while assigning dedicated skills to agents and owners across departments.

nodes.label: Append-Only Events
nodes.rationale: Avoids lost-update races in mutable run records and preserves complete lifecycle history.

nodes.label: Seven Stage Input Analysis Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Every message is processed through pre-classification, extraction, deep analysis, pipeline decision, logging, feedback, and self-improvement.

nodes.label: Self Improvement Loop
nodes.rationale: Proposed changes are collected from logs and feedback, sandbox-tested, operator-approved, and then applied.

nodes.label: TASK-SPEC Workflow
nodes.rationale: TASK-SPEC remains the unconditional source of truth for task gating, ownership, acceptance, security review, and exit proof.

nodes.label: Memory Writer
nodes.rationale: Serializes mutation application within each memory namespace while preserving parallelism across namespaces to prevent duplicate entities and graph corruption.

nodes.label: Optimistic Concurrency
nodes.rationale: Prevents lost updates without holding locks by requiring the row version to match before incrementing it.

nodes.label: Construction-Time Platform Adapter Scoping
nodes.rationale: Removes cross-tenant access capability from the agent by binding client scope during adapter construction, with database RLS as defense in depth.

nodes.label: Agent Build Playbook
nodes.rationale: Defines the standardized, approval-gated process for building agents, skills, operational layers, logical grounding, compilation, and verification.

nodes.label: Input Analysis Pipeline Design
nodes.rationale: Specifies a fixed seven-stage analysis skeleton while allowing keywords, patterns, prompts, and implicit rules to self-improve.

nodes.label: Master Design Rail
nodes.rationale: Acts as the stated single source of truth for the system architecture, workflows, enforcement, and platform design.

nodes.label: Master Plan
nodes.rationale: Sequences chat-pipeline work and records verified, planned, blocked, and condition-gated system capabilities.

nodes.label: Task-Spec Template
nodes.rationale: Defines the required task-spec lifecycle, sharding rules, contract-only handoff, discovery gate, work-item structure, DAG, exit gate, and feedback fields.

nodes.label: TS-018 Full Chat Rollout
nodes.rationale: The rollout is full but probe-gated: repository artifacts may be built, while VPS-dependent changes remain pending until diagnostic evidence exists.

nodes.label: Installing the Graphify VPS Cron
nodes.rationale: Provides a handoff for installing the already-written Graphify pipeline when a real VPS shell is available.

nodes.label: Graph Brain Design
nodes.rationale: Defines the system and execution architecture, including concurrency, memory writes, multi-tenancy, deployment, scaling, and build sequencing.

nodes.label: YVON Graph & System Architecture
nodes.rationale: Governs the /brain graph viewer, its data sources, and its visual model; execution architecture was moved to GRAPH-BRAIN-DESIGN.md.

nodes.rationale: Describes a narrow ephemeral-per-build CLI installation rather than the resident MemPalace service, because Phase 2 remains gated.
